subject: POC trial planning - Veridian Bio (final readout scheduling)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Elena Torres <elena.torres@veridianbio.com>, Jacob Lee <j.lee@veridianbio.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T15:22:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap + draft success criteria (Veridian POC)

Thanks again for the time today - great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Objective: validate Redwood inference for Veridian's internal document summarization pipeline (latency, cost, and fidelity on clinical notes).
- POC length: 3 weeks (recommended).
- Success criteria (attached: veridian_poc_success_criteria.xlsx):
  - Average 95th pct latency <= 300ms for 2k-token requests under 8 QPS sustained
  - Generated summary ROUGE-L >= baseline on the provided eval set
  - No PII leakage; data retention and audit logs observable in Console
- Ownership: Marissa (commercial) + Marcus (technical) from Redwood.
- Next steps:
  1) Internal handshake: Marcus to send trial timeline and tech runbook.
  2) Veridian to confirm success criteria and provide sample eval set + a small test corpus.
  3) Schedule final readout (exec decision) week of June 21.

I've attached a first-pass success criteria workbook and a draft agenda. Can you confirm the acceptance criteria and whether legal/procurement should be looped in now?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: veridian_poc_success_criteria.xlsx, redwood_poc_agenda.docx

From: Jacob Lee <j.lee@veridianbio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Elena Torres <elena.torres@veridianbio.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@veridianbio.com>
Date: 2027-06-13T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft success criteria (Veridian POC)

Thanks Marissa - this is helpful. A few clarifying questions from our side: 

- Data: we'll share the eval set by EOD Thursday. Can you confirm the ingestion path and whether we can test in our VPC/tunnel?
- Latency SLO: 300ms (95th) looks reasonable for typical docs, but can you call out expected tail behavior for 4k tokens? We occasionally hit longer docs.
- Audit/logs: procurement wants to see how long logs are retained and the format for redaction. Can Rachel help provide the retention/ID map?

Also, FYI our CFO Mark Davenport will attend the readout if there are any contract numbers on the table - thought to put that on your radar for scheduling.

-Jacob
Product Manager, NLP
Jacob Lee, Veridian Bio
j.lee@veridianbio.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jacob Lee <j.lee@veridianbio.com>, Dr. Elena Torres <elena.torres@veridianbio.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T11:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft success criteria (Veridian POC)

Great questions - answers below and attaching updated trial_timeline_v2.pdf with estimated tasks/dates.

- Ingestion: we support a secure SFTP or a short-lived signed upload token into a customer-controlled AWS bucket; for Veridian we can also run a VPC peered deployment if you prefer (Marcus can confirm VPN options).
- 4k-token behavior: expected 95th ~650-750ms in our hosted profile; we recommend a quantized model variant if you expect frequent 4k requests to hit sub-second. We call this out in the success criteria sheet.
- Logs/retention: standard Console audit logs are 90-day retention by default; enterprise options for 365 days or log streaming to your SIEM are available. Rachel is looping in the retention docs.

Marcus will be the technical POC and will share the runbook + proposed test harness tomorrow. If procurement wants to start an SOW, Rachel can share the template and next steps.

Thanks - can you confirm availability for a 30-45 min final readout Friday June 21? Per Jacob note, would be helpful if Mark (CFO) can join.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: trial_timeline_v2.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jacob Lee <j.lee@veridianbio.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T17:05:00Z
Subject: Redwood tech runbook + proposed readout times

Hi team - attaching the Redwood tech runbook (redwood_tech_runbook.pdf) with environment setup, test harness instructions, and monitoring checklist. A few logistics: 

- Test harness: we'll provide a dockerized harness that runs the eval set against the POC endpoint and emits latency/quality metrics to a shared Drive folder.
- Data path: recommend signed S3 uploads for initial trial. If you prefer VPC-mode we'll share a separate checklist with IP allowlist and peering steps.
- Monitoring: enable prefix cache for the evaluation to get stable latency numbers; Console will surface token cost and trace IDs for regressions.

For the final readout we propose Friday June 21 (options):
  - 09:00-09:45 PT
  - 11:00-11:45 PT
  - 16:00-16:45 PT (preferred, aligns with Mark's availability per Jacob)

Agenda (30-45 min):
  1) POC outcomes vs success criteria (Marissa)
  2) Technical findings & perf run (Marcus)
  3) Risk checklist & next contract steps (Rachel)
  4) Exec decision / go-no-go (Veridian)

Please confirm preferred time and who will be on the call from your side (Mark, Elena, Jacob, procurement).

- Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Dr. Elena Torres <elena.torres@veridianbio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jacob Lee <j.lee@veridianbio.com>, Procurement <procurement@veridianbio.com>, Mark Davenport <mdavenport@veridianbio.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T16:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood tech runbook + proposed readout times

Thanks everyone - confirming the 16:00-16:45 PT slot on Friday June 21. Attendees from Veridian: Dr. Elena Torres (me), Jacob Lee, Mark Davenport (CFO), and one procurement rep.

We've reviewed the success criteria and the trial timeline - the team is comfortable with the metrics as written pending the initial runs. For next steps on contracting: our procurement team has asked us to start an SOW so procurement can fast-track approval; they expect a short Statement of Work and then a PO. I'll ask them to begin review - they will reach out to Rachel directly.

Also, if you can send the DocuSign SOW link ahead of the readout (even a draft) Mark would like to see the commercial outline during the call. I'll treat the readout as the exec go/no-go: if POC results meet the criteria we'll move to SOW signature and monthly reserved capacity discussions.

See you at 16:00 PT - joining via the calendar invite.

Best,
Elena
VP, Data Science, Veridian Bio
